description: Authoritative mechanical classification of all public exported symbols across Axiom packages into five discrete API tiers.

tiers.stable_facade: Recommended high-level entry points, profiles, model builders, and primary lifecycle handles for application developers.
tiers.advanced: Fine-grained engine configuration, inspection, custom policy tuning, diagnostics, and coordinator primitives.
tiers.extension_spi: Pluggable contracts, interfaces, and backend implementations for storage, admission, caching, and codecs.
tiers.deprecated: Legacy symbols scheduled for deprecation or removal with explicit replacement and migration paths.
tiers.internalization_candidate: Low-level implementation types or AST tokens currently exported across package boundaries that should not be directly depended upon.
